claim_or_observation: CEGAL describes Todos tus Libros as a bibliographic, public-interaction, cultural-diffusion, and commerce platform made through the union of bookshops and associations/guilds.
governance_note: Treat as network-grade store platform, not an official government open-data registry.

claim_or_observation: CEGAL states the platform centralizes book availability information daily and/or in real time and is funded by participating bookshops/associations and commercial information flows.
governance_note: Keep inventory/availability observations separate from store-entity records.

claim_or_observation: TodosTusLibros “Quiénes somos” reports 4,134,504 books and 1,565,475 books for which it can show where to buy.
governance_note: Book counts are not bookstore counts; do not confuse catalogue scale with store-network scale.

claim_or_observation: TTL /librerias exposes a public “Librerías asociadas” search/listing with name and province filters and a paginated list of associated stores.
governance_note: Static HTML listing is crawlable in principle; dynamic geolocation widgets are separate.

claim_or_observation: TTL /librerias page 1 shows store rows with store name, address, city/province, and profile links; observed page pagination runs to page 32.
observed_value: page 1 store rows + page links through 32
governance_note: Use paginated crawl; profiles provide richer contact fields.

claim_or_observation: TTL /librerias page 32 seeded page showed a single store row and page links through 32. This supports 31*25+1 = 776 listing rows if the page size is stable.
observed_value: page 32 one row; inferred listing count 776
governance_note: Treat as probe-supported count, not a final export count, until a complete crawl hashes every profile URL.

claim_or_observation: CEGAL Mapa de Librerías 2024|2025 reports 2,754 independent bookstores identified in Spain.
governance_note: Use this as Spain sector context, not TTL platform membership count.

claim_or_observation: CEGAL Mapa de Librerías 2024|2025 reports 776 bookstores forming part of Todostuslibros.com.
governance_note: This aligns with the observed 32-page TTL listing inference.

claim_or_observation: A TTL store profile exposes richer fields: store name, street address, postal code, city, province, hours, phone, website, and email.
governance_note: Profile crawl should be used for normalized harvest, with listing crawl as profile URL discovery.

claim_or_observation: CEGAL TTL documentation says an API exists for bookshop-management software to export TTL orders/import into local systems and update order status.
governance_note: This does not establish a public bookstore-directory API; treat it as an integration clue only.

claim_or_observation: TTL legal notice identifies the owner/controller as Confederación Española de Gremios y Asociaciones de Librerías (CEGAL).
governance_note: Use CEGAL as source owner / granting network body.
